launcher.notes: LAUNCH SELF-HEAL. The game-not-launching bug is fixed two ways: a valid Kinetrix Ultra Forge jar found in mods/ is now MOVED to its proper libraries/ location instead of deleted (the old sweep could leave the game with NO Forge classes - instant crash with only the client mod left), and when the Ultra Forge jar is unavailable for any reason the launcher restores the plain Forge universal jar before launch, so the classpath can never point at a jar that does not exist. Every launch now preflights the critical files (launchwrapper, the active Forge jar, the 1.8.9 jar and version JSON): anything missing triggers one automatic repair pass, and if something still cannot be restored the launcher says exactly what is missing instead of crashing silently. The version stamped into the game now matches the real launcher version. Bundles Kinetrix Client v3.3.8 Mirror: cosmetics overhaul - scroll fix, every real cape incl. animated, real pets with real names, real aura previews, module-menu window proportions, pause-screen 'Customize Cosmetics' button, remember-me + top-right logout.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. The hub now uses the module menu window proportions (no more near-fullscreen). New "Customize Cosmetics" button on the pause screen for in-world/server customization. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.
